# The Unjournal Data Blog

> Analysis and updates on The Unjournal's evaluation data: ratings, evaluator and author surveys, and what happens to papers after evaluation.

By The Unjournal (https://unjournal.org), a nonprofit that commissions public expert evaluations of impactful research. Published evaluations: https://unjournal.pubpub.org. About: https://info.unjournal.org
